property_summary: For any target address and amount, when the owner calls sendMoney(target, amount) the contract's balance decreases by exactly amount (i.e., the value is forwarded out of the contract) and thus address(c).balance == previous_balance - amount; the mutant that calls address(this).call{value:amount} instead keeps the funds in the contract, breaking this invariant for some inputs.
change_summary: Swap the call target and sender by attempting to call this contract (address(this)) instead of the provided _target, changing which external address receives the value and thus the contract balance after the call.
